independent_human_gate: requires separate two-human agreement report; model outputs do not satisfy it

paired_meeting_uncertainty.limitation: few clusters and retrospective pilot selection limit uncertainty interpretation; not a confirmatory test

compute.annotation_collection: see supplied model collection manifest, if applicable

policy.status: retrospective exploratory development; not prospective confirmation
policy.bank: Terra clean same-span bank selected before filter evaluation
policy.primary_rule: speaker-bound verbatim contiguous quote AND claim support AND correct attribution; rebuttals also answer their paired reason
policy.uncertainty: uncertain in required quote/attribution/support (and rebuttal-answer) fields is rejected; holistic should_keep is an independent audit label, not a filter component; report both separately; no automatic adjudication
policy.selection: do not select thresholds, policies or checker capacity by final role-label accuracy
policy.tie: A when conditional objectives differ by at most 1e-9 objective units; shared post-audit evaluator
policy.human_gate: two independent human annotators; model/proxy judgments cannot satisfy this gate
policy.confirmation_gate: independent human evidence validation and genuinely fresh independently labeled participants/meetings plus a locked meaningful effect and precision target
